att_withdrawal.definition: Pulling back from a partner and reducing contact when closeness or conflict increases.
att_withdrawal.example: Withdrawal is answering with less, not more, when the other person asks for more.

dpn_sunk_cost.definition: Money, time or effort that has already been spent, and which is used as a reason to continue.
dpn_sunk_cost.example: The sunk cost of the training was the argument for staying in the job.

intellectual_humility.definition: The habit of holding your own beliefs with the right amount of confidence: strong when the evidence is strong, weak when it is weak.

jacket.definition: A thicker top you wear over your shirt when it is cold or wet.
jacket.example: I wear a jacket when it is cold in the morning.

limit.definition: The point at which you stop giving: the time, the amount or the effort. A limit is the measurable side of a boundary.
limit.example: My limit is two favours a week, and I stick to it.

psy_authority.definition: A pressure tactic that puts the decision in the hands of an expert, real or claimed.
psy_authority.example: It used authority: the technician said the part was safe, and showed no manual.

pump_well.definition: A deep hole dug in the ground that holds the water a pump lifts.
pump_well.example: The pump hangs ten metres down inside the well.
